cues: The silver half reaction had to be doubled to balance two electrons, but its E nought stays plus zero point eight zero.
Electrode potential is energy per unit charge, so it does not depend on how much reaction you write.
Only delta G scales with the number of electrons.
text: A trap. The silver half reaction had to be doubled to balance two electrons, but its E nought stays plus zero point eight zero. Electrode potential is energy per unit charge, so it does not depend on how much reaction you write. Only delta G scales with the number of electrons.
